heading: Choose a plot around your budget
text: Our available plots are offered on full payment. No 5 marla or 5.56 Marla plots are currently offered on installments. Limited installment options may be available in K Block for 10 marla and above only, subject to confirmation on WhatsApp. Compare sectors, review the map and request a current price breakdown.
